name: 14787 · Westfield, NY
findings: ZIP 14787 (Westfield) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14787 (Westfield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14787 (Westfield) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
